title: Vimeo video display issue
issue: Vimeo player not displaying correctly. URL visible instead of player.
solution: To embed a Vimeo video, ensure to paste only the URL without the whole iframe code.

title: WooCommerce columns layout behavior
solution: To adjust the number of columns for your WooCommerce products shop page, go to Appearance > Customize > Shop tab. The number of column will always be reduced on mobile deviced below 500px as the theme handles responsiveness across all devices sizes automatically
